sourceAnchors.finding: Battery budget armed only for battery sources; last-consumer detach arms linger; teardown calls stream.stop.
Attached media settles periodic full starts; stall reassertion follows own-media silence; stop detaches listeners and sends stopLiveMedia.
Retain cancels idle; wired session has no idle timer; idle/reset closure reaches session.close.
Key set has no expiry; connect socket changes are connection establishment; stop sends DATA; close clears key/sequencing and sends END.
Always-mode cameras are not stopped by hold expiry.
LAN-upgrade driver is inactive when lan.force is true; resets would close station sessions.

heartbeatMetadata.finding: No changing heartbeat payload/echo field in these captures.

conclusion: No observed pre-cut ownership action or demonstrated ownership defect explains initial media loss. These exclusions cover source teardown, socket/session/key close, sibling/base DATA commands, and omitted last-packet local ACK. Packet-tap ACK presence does not prove peer receipt, and missing protocol renewal/start semantics remain outside this exclusion.
